text:
alex: FYI support flagged a new user hit a confusing combo: quickstart shows `async with Client.from_env() as client:` but the sample app uses plain `Client()` and CI mypy on their side failed because example type hints are wrong. also they got 502s during retries.

jamie: can you paste both snippets?

alex: docs async snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
async def main():
    async with Client.from_env() as client:
        resp = await client.chat.generate(messages)
        print(resp)
```

alex: sample app:```python
from redwood import Client
client: Client | None = Client(os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.chat.generate(messages)
print(resp)
```

ryan: two separate issues: 1) the sample's type annotation `Client | None` is Python 3.9+ union syntax but our docs target 3.8 in quickstart; it breaks mypy for some users. 2) sample doesn't await `client.chat.generate` so async vs sync mismatch.

molly: what's with the retries/502? user said the client retried silently and then crashed with a generic "ServerError". maybe default retry config changed but docs didn't mention it.

docs-bot: scanned repo: found 3 places using `async with Client.from_env()` and 5 sample files using plain `Client()` without context manager. Found type hints using `Client | None` in examples; also found references to `max_retries=3` in old docs but not in new quickstart.

ajamie: we should do a few things: a) standardize examples to show both sync and async variants, correct await usage, and avoid Python 3.10+ syntax in samples (use Optional[Client] from typing). b) add a short section on retry behavior in quickstart that explains default backoff and how to configure `client.configure_retries(backoff_factor=...)`. c) add a mypy/docs CI check that runs examples through a simple mypy pass against pyproject settings.

ryan: SDK follow-up: default retry behavior currently swallows body and raises a generic ServerError on 502. we should include response body in debug logs and provide a clearer exception type (e.g., BadGatewayError) to help users. Filed SDK issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/410.

molly: also this user's support ticket included a broken docs link: quickstart page links to `/docs/python/async-context` which 404s. looks like the permalink changed after we moved the async guide.

docs-bot: created redirect ticket and search for hardcoded links. Suggested quick fixes: update examples to use `from typing import Optional` and `client: Optional[Client] = None` or avoid the annotation entirely in simple examples; update async snippets to `resp = await client.chat.generate(...)`; add a Retry and Exceptions FAQ entry; add mypy smoke job for docs CI.

alex: I'll open a docs PR to: - replace `Client | None` with `Optional[Client]` in examples - add explicit sync + async examples side-by-side - add a short "Handling transient 502s" box showing `from redwood.retry import RetryConfig` and example config - update broken permalinks and add redirect ticket link in PR description.

jamie: thanks. I'll follow up on the SDK issue to make errors more actionable and include response snippets when debug logging enabled. also will add a deprecation note if we change exception classes.

molly: CI note: when I ran the new smoke test it failed on Windows runners because of backslash path in sample `.env` loader; added a tiny path normalize in examples and a note in troubleshooting.

alex: PR #921 opened with fixes and a docs CI mypy job. PR includes example code linting changes and the retry explanation. I'll ping support to update the canned reply.

jamie: nice. lesson: small typing/async copy drift + missing retry docs causes more onboarding friction than you'd expect. :memo:
